description: List a project's reviews with their current state — the only way to learn what happened to a review you opened, since the API has no endpoints for approving or merging — those are UI-only. Filter by status to see what is still open. For one review by ID, qase_get is cheaper. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s.

author_uuid.description: Only reviews opened by this author UUID

case_id.description: Only reviews of this test case

offset.description: Skip this many reviews, for paging

reviewer_uuid.description: Only reviews this author UUID is a reviewer on

search.description: Substring match on the review title

type.description: "create" proposes a new case, "edit" proposes changes to an existing one

name: qase_review_list
title: List case reviews
